student_learning_goal: I can pick a non-standard unit and explain the inverse relationship.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can pick a non-standard unit and explain the inverse relationship.
header.character_watermark: Roo with a ruler in the top-right. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Match each object to the BEST non-standard unit (cubes/hand-spans/footsteps).
parts.visual_layout: 5 objects on left, 3 unit choices repeated; line-drawing match.

image_placeholders.description: A two-column match for Grade 2 worksheet, B&W line art. Left: 5 objects (pencil, book, desk, hallway, room). Right: 3 unit choices (cubes, hand-spans, footsteps).

parts.answer_key: Pencil → cubes. Book → cubes/hand-spans. Desk → hand-spans. Hallway → footsteps. Room → footsteps.

parts.student_instructions: Measure a pencil with cubes AND hand-spans. Note the inverse.
parts.visual_layout: Two columns: cubes column + hand-spans column.

image_placeholders.description: Two-column table for Grade 2 worksheet. Left: 'Cubes: ___'. Right: 'Hand-spans: ___'. Below: 'Why are they different?'

parts.answer_key: Pencil ≈ 18 cubes / 1 hand-span. Reasoning: smaller unit = more units.

parts.student_instructions: Pick 3 home objects. Choose unit and measure.
parts.visual_layout: Three numbered rows for the child to write objects, units, and counts at home.
